Ez egy **Julia programkód**, amely egy rendkívül összetett és átfogó **AlphaFold 3 fehérjeszerkezet-előrejelző modell** implementációját tartalmazza, számos speciális kiterjesztéssel és optimalizációval[1].

## Fő komponensek és funkciók

### Neurális hálózati architektúra
A kód a DeepMind AlphaFold 3 modelljének teljes reimplementációját valósítja meg Julia nyelven, beleértve az **Evoformer blokkokat** (48+ blokk támogatással), **MSA feldolgozást**, **páros reprezentációkat** és **diffúziós fejeket** a 3D szerkezet generálásához[1].

### Kvantumszámítógép integráció
Különleges funkció a **kvantumszámítógép támogatás**, amely integrálja az **IQM és IBM Quantum** platformokat. Ez lehetővé teszi kvantumalgoritmusok alkalmazását a fehérje-összehajtás számításában, potenciálisan növelve a pontosságot[1].

### Optimalizálási technikák
A kód számos teljesítményoptimalizálást tartalmaz, például **SIMD vektorizációt**, **CUDA GPU gyorsítást**, **memória pooling**-ot és **quantization** támogatást (4-bit aktivációs quantizálás). Ezek jelentősen felgyorsíthatják a számításokat nagy fehérje struktúráknál[1].

### AlphaFold adatbázis integráció
Tartalmaz egy komplett **AlphaFold Database** kezelőt, amely több mint 40 organizmus (ember, egér, E. coli stb.) proteomját támogatja az EBI AlphaFold v4 adatbázisból történő letöltéshez és feldolgozáshoz[1].

## Értékelés

**Erősségek:** A kód rendkívül ambiciózus és átfogó implementáció, amely kombinálja a legmodernebb gépi tanulási technikákat (Evoformer, diffúziós modellek, Attention mechanizmusok) kvantumszámítógépes fejlesztésekkel. A kódminőség magas, jól strukturált, részletes dokumentációval[1].

**Kihívások:** Az ilyen komplexitású modell óriási számítási erőforrásokat igényel - több GPU-t, nagy memóriát és valószínűleg több órás/napos futási időt egyetlen fehérje előrejelzéséhez. A kvantumintegráció még experimentális fázisban van[1].

struct MemoryPool
    buffers::Dict{Tuple{Type,Vararg{Int}},Vector{Any}}
    lock::ReentrantLock
    max_size::Int
    current_size::Int
end

function MemoryPool(max_size::Int=10^9)
    return MemoryPool(Dict{Tuple{Type,Vararg{Int}},Vector{Any}}(), ReentrantLock(), max_size, 0)
end

function get_buffer(pool::MemoryPool, T::Type, dims...)
    lock(pool.lock) do
        key = (T, dims...)
        if haskey(pool.buffers, key) && !isempty(pool.buffers[key])
            return pop!(pool.buffers[key])
        else
            return zeros(T, dims...)
        end
    end
end

function return_buffer!(pool::MemoryPool, buffer::AbstractArray)
    lock(pool.lock) do
        T = eltype(buffer)
        dims = size(buffer)
        key = (T, dims...)
        if !haskey(pool.buffers, key)
            pool.buffers[key] = Vector{Any}()
        end
        push!(pool.buffers[key], buffer)
    end
end

mutable struct QuantizationConfig
    enabled::Bool
    bits::Int
    activation_quant::Bool
    weight_quant::Bool
    scale_cache::Dict{String,Float32}
end

function QuantizationConfig(; enabled=false, bits=8, activation_quant=true, weight_quant=true)
    return QuantizationConfig(enabled, bits, activation_quant, weight_quant, Dict{String,Float32}())
end

function quantize(x::AbstractArray{T}, config::QuantizationConfig, name::String="") where T
    if !config.enabled
        return x
    end
    
    max_val = maximum(abs.(x))
    if max_val == 0
        return x
    end
    
    levels = 2^config.bits - 1
    scale = max_val / (levels / 2)
    
    if name != ""
        config.scale_cache[name] = Float32(scale)
    end
    
    quantized = round.(x ./ scale)
    return quantized .* scale
end

function dequantize(x::AbstractArray, config::QuantizationConfig, name::String="")
    if !config.enabled || !haskey(config.scale_cache, name)
        return x
    end
    
    scale = config.scale_cache[name]
    return x .* scale
end

struct LinearNoBias{T<:AbstractFloat}
    weight::Matrix{T}
    in_features::Int
    out_features::Int
end

function LinearNoBias(T::Type, in_features::Int, out_features::Int)
    weight = randn(T, out_features, in_features) .* T(sqrt(2.0 / in_features))
    return LinearNoBias{T}(weight, in_features, out_features)
end

function (layer::LinearNoBias{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
        out = similar(x, size(layer.weight, 1), size(x, 2))
        @turbo for j in 1:size(x, 2)
            for i in 1:size(layer.weight, 1)
                acc = zero(T)
                for k in 1:size(layer.weight, 2)
                    acc += layer.weight[i, k] * x[k, j]
                end
                out[i, j] = acc
            end
        end
        return out
    elseif OCTAVIAN_AVAILABLE
        return Octavian.matmul(layer.weight, x)
    else
        return layer.weight * x
    end
end

struct LayerNorm{T<:AbstractFloat}
    weight::Vector{T}
    bias::Vector{T}
    eps::T
    normalized_shape::Int
end

function LayerNorm(T::Type, normalized_shape::Int; eps::T=T(1e-5)) where T<:AbstractFloat
    weight = ones(T, normalized_shape)
    bias = zeros(T, normalized_shape)
    return LayerNorm{T}(weight, bias, eps, normalized_shape)
end

function (ln::LayerNorm{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    dims_to_normalize = ndims(x)
    
    if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
        mean_val = mean(x, dims=dims_to_normalize)
        var_val = var(x, dims=dims_to_normalize, corrected=false)
        normalized = (x .- mean_val) ./ sqrt.(var_val .+ ln.eps)
        
        if ndims(x) == 2
            return normalized .* reshape(ln.weight, :, 1) .+ reshape(ln.bias, :, 1)
        else
            return normalized .* ln.weight .+ ln.bias
        end
    else
        mean_val = mean(x, dims=dims_to_normalize)
        var_val = var(x, dims=dims_to_normalize, corrected=false)
        normalized = (x .- mean_val) ./ sqrt.(var_val .+ ln.eps)
        
        if ndims(x) == 2
            return normalized .* reshape(ln.weight, :, 1) .+ reshape(ln.bias, :, 1)
        else
            return normalized .* ln.weight .+ ln.bias
        end
    end
end

struct GELU end

function (::GELU)(x::T) where T<:AbstractFloat
    return T(0.5) * x * (T(1.0) + tanh(T(sqrt(2.0/π)) * (x + T(0.044715) * x^3)))
end

function (gelu::GELU)(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T<:AbstractFloat
    if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
        out = similar(x)
        @turbo for i in eachindex(x)
            xi = x[i]
            out[i] = T(0.5) * xi * (T(1.0) + tanh(T(0.797884560803) * (xi + T(0.044715) * xi * xi * xi)))
        end
        return out
    else
        return map(xi -> gelu(xi), x)
    end
end

struct SiLU end

function (::SiLU)(x::T) where T<:AbstractFloat
    return x / (T(1.0) + exp(-x))
end

function (silu::SiLU)(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T<:AbstractFloat
    if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
        out = similar(x)
        @turbo for i in eachindex(x)
            xi = x[i]
            out[i] = xi / (T(1.0) + exp(-xi))
        end
        return out
    else
        return map(xi -> silu(xi), x)
    end
end

struct Attention{T<:AbstractFloat}
    q_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    k_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    v_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    out_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    heads::Int
    dim_head::Int
    dropout::T
end

function Attention(T::Type, dim::Int; heads::Int=8, dim_head::Int=64, dropout::T=T(0.0)) where T<:AbstractFloat
    inner_dim = heads * dim_head
    q_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, inner_dim)
    k_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, inner_dim)
    v_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, inner_dim)
    out_proj = LinearNoBias(T, inner_dim, dim)
    return Attention{T}(q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj, heads, dim_head, dropout)
end

function (attn::Attention{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}; mask=nothing) where T
    batch_size = size(x, 2)
    seq_len = size(x, 1)
    
    q = attn.q_proj(x)
    k = attn.k_proj(x)
    v = attn.v_proj(x)
    
    q = reshape(q, attn.dim_head, attn.heads, seq_len, batch_size)
    k = reshape(k, attn.dim_head, attn.heads, seq_len, batch_size)
    v = reshape(v, attn.dim_head, attn.heads, seq_len, batch_size)
    
    q = permutedims(q, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    k = permutedims(k, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    v = permutedims(v, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    scale = T(1.0) / sqrt(T(attn.dim_head))
    
    if TULLIO_AVAILABLE
        @tullio scores[i, j, h, b] := q[d, i, h, b] * k[d, j, h, b] * scale
    else
        scores = zeros(T, seq_len, seq_len, attn.heads, batch_size)
        if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
            @turbo for b in 1:batch_size
                for h in 1:attn.heads
                    for j in 1:seq_len
                        for i in 1:seq_len
                            acc = zero(T)
                            for d in 1:attn.dim_head
                                acc += q[d, i, h, b] * k[d, j, h, b]
                            end
                            scores[i, j, h, b] = acc * scale
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            for b in 1:batch_size
                for h in 1:attn.heads
                    for i in 1:seq_len
                        for j in 1:seq_len
                            acc = zero(T)
                            for d in 1:attn.dim_head
                                acc += q[d, i, h, b] * k[d, j, h, b]
                            end
                            scores[i, j, h, b] = acc * scale
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if mask !== nothing
        scores = scores .+ mask
    end
    
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=2)
    
    if TULLIO_AVAILABLE
        @tullio out[d, i, h, b] := attn_weights[i, j, h, b] * v[d, j, h, b]
    else
        out = zeros(T, attn.dim_head, seq_len, attn.heads, batch_size)
        if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
            @turbo for b in 1:batch_size
                for h in 1:attn.heads
                    for i in 1:seq_len
                        for d in 1:attn.dim_head
                            acc = zero(T)
                            for j in 1:seq_len
                                acc += attn_weights[i, j, h, b] * v[d, j, h, b]
                            end
                            out[d, i, h, b] = acc
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            for b in 1:batch_size
                for h in 1:attn.heads
                    for i in 1:seq_len
                        for d in 1:attn.dim_head
                            acc = zero(T)
                            for j in 1:seq_len
                                acc += attn_weights[i, j, h, b] * v[d, j, h, b]
                            end
                            out[d, i, h, b] = acc
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    out = reshape(out, attn.heads * attn.dim_head, seq_len, batch_size)
    
    out = attn.out_proj(out)
    
    return out
end

function softmax(x::AbstractArray{T}, dims) where T
    x_max = maximum(x, dims=dims)
    x_exp = exp.(x .- x_max)
    return x_exp ./ sum(x_exp, dims=dims)
end

struct AttentionPairBias{T<:AbstractFloat}
    q_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    k_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    v_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    out_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    pair_bias_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    heads::Int
    dim_head::Int
    dropout::T
end

function AttentionPairBias(T::Type, dim::Int; dim_pairwise::Int=128, heads::Int=8, dim_head::Int=64, dropout::T=T(0.0)) where T<:AbstractFloat
    inner_dim = heads * dim_head
    q_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, inner_dim)
    k_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, inner_dim)
    v_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, inner_dim)
    out_proj = LinearNoBias(T, inner_dim, dim)
    pair_bias_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim_pairwise, heads)
    return AttentionPairBias{T}(q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj, pair_bias_proj, heads, dim_head, dropout)
end

function (attn::AttentionPairBias{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}, pair_repr::AbstractArray{T}; mask=nothing) where T
    batch_size = size(x, 2)
    seq_len = size(x, 1)
    
    q = attn.q_proj(x)
    k = attn.k_proj(x)
    v = attn.v_proj(x)
    
    q = reshape(q, attn.dim_head, attn.heads, seq_len, batch_size)
    k = reshape(k, attn.dim_head, attn.heads, seq_len, batch_size)
    v = reshape(v, attn.dim_head, attn.heads, seq_len, batch_size)
    
    q = permutedims(q, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    k = permutedims(k, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    v = permutedims(v, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    scale = T(1.0) / sqrt(T(attn.dim_head))
    
    scores = zeros(T, seq_len, seq_len, attn.heads, batch_size)
    for b in 1:batch_size
        for h in 1:attn.heads
            for i in 1:seq_len
                for j in 1:seq_len
                    acc = zero(T)
                    for d in 1:attn.dim_head
                        acc += q[d, i, h, b] * k[d, j, h, b]
                    end
                    scores[i, j, h, b] = acc * scale
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    pair_bias = attn.pair_bias_proj(pair_repr)
    pair_bias = reshape(pair_bias, seq_len, seq_len, attn.heads, batch_size)
    
    scores = scores .+ pair_bias
    
    if mask !== nothing
        scores = scores .+ mask
    end
    
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=2)
    
    out = zeros(T, attn.dim_head, seq_len, attn.heads, batch_size)
    for b in 1:batch_size
        for h in 1:attn.heads
            for i in 1:seq_len
                for d in 1:attn.dim_head
                    acc = zero(T)
                    for j in 1:seq_len
                        acc += attn_weights[i, j, h, b] * v[d, j, h, b]
                    end
                    out[d, i, h, b] = acc
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    out = reshape(out, attn.heads * attn.dim_head, seq_len, batch_size)
    
    out = attn.out_proj(out)
    
    return out
end

struct Transition{T<:AbstractFloat}
    linear1::LinearNoBias{T}
    linear2::LinearNoBias{T}
    activation::GELU
    dropout::T
end

function Transition(T::Type, dim::Int; mult::Int=4, dropout::T=T(0.0)) where T<:AbstractFloat
    hidden_dim = dim * mult
    linear1 = LinearNoBias(T, dim, hidden_dim)
    linear2 = LinearNoBias(T, hidden_dim, dim)
    return Transition{T}(linear1, linear2, GELU(), dropout)
end

function (trans::Transition{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    h = trans.linear1(x)
    h = trans.activation(h)
    h = trans.linear2(h)
    return h
end

struct PreLayerNorm{T<:AbstractFloat,F}
    norm::LayerNorm{T}
    fn::F
end

function PreLayerNorm(fn::F, dim::Int, T::Type=Float32) where F
    norm = LayerNorm(T, dim)
    return PreLayerNorm{T,F}(norm, fn)
end

function (pln::PreLayerNorm)(x, args...; kwargs...)
    return pln.fn(pln.norm(x), args...; kwargs...)
end

struct EvoformerBlock{T<:AbstractFloat}
    msa_row_attn::PreLayerNorm{T}
    msa_col_attn::PreLayerNorm{T}
    msa_transition::PreLayerNorm{T}
    pair_attn_row::PreLayerNorm{T}
    pair_attn_col::PreLayerNorm{T}
    pair_transition::PreLayerNorm{T}
    outer_product::LinearNoBias{T}
    outer_product_norm::LayerNorm{T}
    dim_msa::Int
    dim_pair::Int
end

function EvoformerBlock(T::Type, dim_msa::Int, dim_pair::Int; heads::Int=8, dim_head::Int=32)
    msa_attn_row = Attention(T, dim_msa, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    msa_row_attn = PreLayerNorm(msa_attn_row, dim_msa, T)
    
    msa_attn_col = Attention(T, dim_msa, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    msa_col_attn = PreLayerNorm(msa_attn_col, dim_msa, T)
    
    msa_trans = Transition(T, dim_msa, mult=4)
    msa_transition = PreLayerNorm(msa_trans, dim_msa, T)
    
    pair_attn_r = AttentionPairBias(T, dim_pair, dim_pairwise=dim_pair, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    pair_attn_row = PreLayerNorm(pair_attn_r, dim_pair, T)
    
    pair_attn_c = AttentionPairBias(T, dim_pair, dim_pairwise=dim_pair, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    pair_attn_col = PreLayerNorm(pair_attn_c, dim_pair, T)
    
    pair_trans = Transition(T, dim_pair, mult=4)
    pair_transition = PreLayerNorm(pair_trans, dim_pair, T)
    
    outer_product = LinearNoBias(T, dim_msa * dim_msa, dim_pair)
    outer_product_norm = LayerNorm(T, dim_msa)
    
    return EvoformerBlock{T}(
        msa_row_attn, msa_col_attn, msa_transition,
        pair_attn_row, pair_attn_col, pair_transition,
        outer_product, outer_product_norm,
        dim_msa, dim_pair
    )
end

function (block::EvoformerBlock{T})(msa::AbstractArray{T}, pair::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_seqs, seq_len, batch = size(msa)
    
    msa_row_in = reshape(msa, num_seqs, seq_len * batch)
    msa_row_out = block.msa_row_attn(msa_row_in)
    msa = msa .+ reshape(msa_row_out, num_seqs, seq_len, batch)
    
    msa_col = permutedims(msa, (2, 1, 3))
    msa_col_in = reshape(msa_col, seq_len, num_seqs * batch)
    msa_col_out = block.msa_col_attn(msa_col_in)
    msa_col = reshape(msa_col_out, seq_len, num_seqs, batch)
    msa = msa .+ permutedims(msa_col, (2, 1, 3))
    
    msa_trans_in = reshape(msa, num_seqs, seq_len * batch)
    msa_trans_out = block.msa_transition(msa_trans_in)
    msa = msa .+ reshape(msa_trans_out, num_seqs, seq_len, batch)
    
    msa_normed = block.outer_product_norm(reshape(msa, num_seqs, seq_len * batch))
    msa_normed = reshape(msa_normed, num_seqs, seq_len, batch)
    
    outer = zeros(T, seq_len, seq_len, block.dim_msa * block.dim_msa, batch)
    for b in 1:batch
        for i in 1:seq_len
            for j in 1:seq_len
                msa_i = msa_normed[:, i, b]
                msa_j = msa_normed[:, j, b]
                outer_ij = kron(msa_i, msa_j)
                outer[i, j, :, b] = outer_ij
            end
        end
    end
    
    outer_proj = block.outer_product(reshape(outer, seq_len * seq_len, block.dim_msa * block.dim_msa * batch))
    outer_proj = reshape(outer_proj, seq_len, seq_len, block.dim_pair, batch)
    pair = pair .+ outer_proj
    
    pair_row_in = reshape(pair, seq_len, seq_len * block.dim_pair * batch)
    pair_row_out = block.pair_attn_row(pair_row_in, pair)
    pair = pair .+ reshape(pair_row_out, seq_len, seq_len, block.dim_pair, batch)
    
    pair_col = permutedims(pair, (2, 1, 3, 4))
    pair_col_in = reshape(pair_col, seq_len, seq_len * block.dim_pair * batch)
    pair_col_out = block.pair_attn_col(pair_col_in, pair_col)
    pair_col = reshape(pair_col_out, seq_len, seq_len, block.dim_pair, batch)
    pair = pair .+ permutedims(pair_col, (2, 1, 3, 4))
    
    pair_trans_in = reshape(pair, seq_len * seq_len, block.dim_pair * batch)
    pair_trans_out = block.pair_transition(pair_trans_in)
    pair = pair .+ reshape(pair_trans_out, seq_len, seq_len, block.dim_pair, batch)
    
    return msa, pair
end

struct DiffusionHead{T<:AbstractFloat}
    time_embed::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    pos_embed::LinearNoBias{T}
    blocks::Vector{Any}
    final_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    dim::Int
    time_dim::Int
    num_blocks::Int
end

function DiffusionHead(T::Type, dim::Int, time_dim::Int; num_blocks::Int=12, heads::Int=8, dim_head::Int=64)
    time_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, time_dim, dim), LinearNoBias(T, dim, dim)]
    pos_embed = LinearNoBias(T, 3, dim)
    
    blocks = []
    for i in 1:num_blocks
        attn = Attention(T, dim, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
        attn_ln = PreLayerNorm(attn, dim, T)
        trans = Transition(T, dim, mult=4)
        trans_ln = PreLayerNorm(trans, dim, T)
        push!(blocks, (attn_ln, trans_ln))
    end
    
    final_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 3)
    
    return DiffusionHead{T}(time_layers, pos_embed, blocks, final_proj, dim, time_dim, num_blocks)
end

function (head::DiffusionHead{T})(coords::AbstractArray{T}, single_repr::AbstractArray{T}, t::T) where T
    num_atoms, _, batch = size(coords)
    
    time_emb = ones(T, head.time_dim) .* t
    for layer in head.time_embed
        time_emb = layer(reshape(time_emb, :, 1))
        time_emb = GELU()(time_emb)
    end
    time_emb = reshape(time_emb, head.dim)
    
    coords_flat = reshape(coords, num_atoms, 3 * batch)
    pos_emb = head.pos_embed(coords_flat)
    
    x = single_repr .+ reshape(pos_emb, num_atoms, head.dim, batch) .+ reshape(time_emb, 1, head.dim, 1)
    
    x_reshaped = reshape(x, num_atoms, head.dim * batch)
    
    for (attn_ln, trans_ln) in head.blocks
        x_reshaped = x_reshaped .+ attn_ln(x_reshaped)
        x_reshaped = x_reshaped .+ trans_ln(x_reshaped)
    end
    
    x = reshape(x_reshaped, num_atoms, head.dim, batch)
    
    coords_delta_flat = head.final_proj(x_reshaped)
    coords_delta = reshape(coords_delta_flat, num_atoms, 3, batch)
    
    return coords_delta
end

function ddpm_sample(diffusion::DiffusionHead{T}, single_repr::AbstractArray{T}, num_atoms::Int, batch::Int; num_steps::Int=100, beta_start::T=T(1e-4), beta_end::T=T(0.02)) where T
    betas = LinRange(beta_start, beta_end, num_steps)
    alphas = T(1.0) .- betas
    alphas_cumprod = cumprod(alphas)
    
    coords = randn(T, num_atoms, 3, batch)
    
    for step in num_steps:-1:1
        t = T(step) / T(num_steps)
        
        noise_pred = diffusion(coords, single_repr, t)
        
        alpha_t = alphas[step]
        alpha_bar_t = alphas_cumprod[step]
        
        if step > 1
            noise = randn(T, size(coords)...)
            alpha_bar_prev = alphas_cumprod[step-1]
            sigma_t = sqrt((T(1.0) - alpha_bar_prev) / (T(1.0) - alpha_bar_t) * (T(1.0) - alpha_t))
        else
            noise = zeros(T, size(coords)...)
            sigma_t = T(0.0)
        end
        
        coords = (coords .- (T(1.0) - alpha_t) / sqrt(T(1.0) - alpha_bar_t) .* noise_pred) ./ sqrt(alpha_t)
        coords = coords .+ sigma_t .* noise
    end
    
    return coords
end

struct AlphaFold3{T<:AbstractFloat}
    msa_embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    pair_embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    single_embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    evoformer_blocks::Vector{EvoformerBlock{T}}
    single_head::Vector{Any}
    diffusion_head::DiffusionHead{T}
    dim_msa::Int
    dim_pair::Int
    dim_single::Int
    num_blocks::Int
    num_recycles::Int
    quantization::QuantizationConfig
end

function AlphaFold3(T::Type; dim_msa::Int=256, dim_pair::Int=128, dim_single::Int=384, num_blocks::Int=48, num_recycles::Int=3, heads::Int=8, dim_head::Int=32, use_quantization::Bool=false)
    msa_embedding = LinearNoBias(T, 49, dim_msa)
    pair_embedding = LinearNoBias(T, 65, dim_pair)
    single_embedding = LinearNoBias(T, 21, dim_single)
    
    evoformer_blocks = [EvoformerBlock(T, dim_msa, dim_pair, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head) for _ in 1:num_blocks]
    
    single_layers = []
    for i in 1:6
        attn = Attention(T, dim_single, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
        attn_ln = PreLayerNorm(attn, dim_single, T)
        trans = Transition(T, dim_single, mult=4)
        trans_ln = PreLayerNorm(trans, dim_single, T)
        push!(single_layers, (attn_ln, trans_ln))
    end
    
    time_dim = dim_single
    diffusion_head = DiffusionHead(T, dim_single, time_dim, num_blocks=12, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    
    quant_config = QuantizationConfig(enabled=use_quantization, bits=4, activation_quant=true, weight_quant=false)
    
    return AlphaFold3{T}(
        msa_embedding, pair_embedding, single_embedding,
        evoformer_blocks, single_layers, diffusion_head,
        dim_msa, dim_pair, dim_single,
        num_blocks, num_recycles, quant_config
    )
end

function (model::AlphaFold3{T})(msa_tokens::AbstractArray{Int}, pair_tokens::AbstractArray{Int}, single_tokens::AbstractArray{Int}; return_structure::Bool=true) where T
    num_seqs, seq_len, batch = size(msa_tokens)
    
    msa_onehot = zeros(T, num_seqs, 49, seq_len, batch)
    for b in 1:batch
        for s in 1:num_seqs
            for i in 1:seq_len
                token = msa_tokens[s, i, b]
                if token >= 1 && token <= 49
                    msa_onehot[s, token, i, b] = T(1.0)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    msa = model.msa_embedding(reshape(msa_onehot, num_seqs, 49 * seq_len * batch))
    msa = reshape(msa, num_seqs, model.dim_msa, seq_len, batch)
    msa = permutedims(msa, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    msa = reshape(msa, num_seqs, seq_len, model.dim_msa, batch)
    msa = msa[:, :, :, :]
    
    pair_onehot = zeros(T, seq_len, seq_len, 65, batch)
    for b in 1:batch
        for i in 1:seq_len
            for j in 1:seq_len
                token = pair_tokens[i, j, b]
                if token >= 1 && token <= 65
                    pair_onehot[i, j, token, b] = T(1.0)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    pair = model.pair_embedding(reshape(pair_onehot, seq_len * seq_len, 65 * batch))
    pair = reshape(pair, seq_len, seq_len, model.dim_pair, batch)
    
    single_onehot = zeros(T, seq_len, 21, batch)
    for b in 1:batch
        for i in 1:seq_len
            token = single_tokens[i, b]
            if token >= 1 && token <= 21
                single_onehot[i, token, b] = T(1.0)
            end
        end
    end
    
    single = model.single_embedding(reshape(single_onehot, seq_len, 21 * batch))
    single = reshape(single, seq_len, model.dim_single, batch)
    
    msa_3d = reshape(msa, num_seqs, seq_len, model.dim_msa * batch)
    
    for recycle in 1:model.num_recycles
        msa_cycle = copy(msa_3d)
        pair_cycle = copy(pair)
        
        for block in model.evoformer_blocks
            msa_cycle_reshaped = reshape(msa_cycle, num_seqs, seq_len, model.dim_msa, batch)
            msa_cycle, pair_cycle = block(msa_cycle_reshaped, pair_cycle)
            msa_cycle = reshape(msa_cycle, num_seqs, seq_len, model.dim_msa * batch)
        end
        
        msa_3d = msa_cycle
        pair = pair_cycle
    end
    
    single_repr = reshape(single, seq_len, model.dim_single * batch)
    for (attn_ln, trans_ln) in model.single_head
        single_repr = single_repr .+ attn_ln(single_repr)
        single_repr = single_repr .+ trans_ln(single_repr)
    end
    single_repr = reshape(single_repr, seq_len, model.dim_single, batch)
    
    if !return_structure
        return msa_3d, pair, single_repr
    end
    
    coords = ddpm_sample(model.diffusion_head, single_repr, seq_len, batch, num_steps=100)
    
    return coords, single_repr, pair
end

struct ProteinLanguageModel{T<:AbstractFloat}
    embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    transformer_blocks::Vector{Any}
    output_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    vocab_size::Int
    dim::Int
    num_layers::Int
end

function ProteinLanguageModel(T::Type; vocab_size::Int=33, dim::Int=1280, num_layers::Int=33, heads::Int=20)
    embedding = LinearNoBias(T, vocab_size, dim)
    
    blocks = []
    for i in 1:num_layers
        attn = Attention(T, dim, heads=heads, dim_head=div(dim, heads))
        attn_ln = PreLayerNorm(attn, dim, T)
        trans = Transition(T, dim, mult=4)
        trans_ln = PreLayerNorm(trans, dim, T)
        push!(blocks, (attn_ln, trans_ln))
    end
    
    output_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, vocab_size)
    
    return ProteinLanguageModel{T}(embedding, blocks, output_proj, vocab_size, dim, num_layers)
end

function (plm::ProteinLanguageModel{T})(tokens::AbstractArray{Int}) where T
    seq_len, batch = size(tokens)
    
    onehot = zeros(T, seq_len, plm.vocab_size, batch)
    for b in 1:batch
        for i in 1:seq_len
            token = tokens[i, b]
            if token >= 1 && token <= plm.vocab_size
                onehot[i, token, b] = T(1.0)
            end
        end
    end
    
    x = plm.embedding(reshape(onehot, seq_len, plm.vocab_size * batch))
    x = reshape(x, seq_len, plm.dim, batch)
    
    x_reshaped = reshape(x, seq_len, plm.dim * batch)
    
    for (attn_ln, trans_ln) in plm.transformer_blocks
        x_reshaped = x_reshaped .+ attn_ln(x_reshaped)
        x_reshaped = x_reshaped .+ trans_ln(x_reshaped)
    end
    
    logits = plm.output_proj(x_reshaped)
    logits = reshape(logits, seq_len, plm.vocab_size, batch)
    
    return logits, reshape(x_reshaped, seq_len, plm.dim, batch)
end

struct PairformerBlock{T<:AbstractFloat}
    pair_self_attn::PreLayerNorm{T}
    pair_cross_attn::PreLayerNorm{T}
    pair_transition::PreLayerNorm{T}
    triangle_mult_out::LinearNoBias{T}
    triangle_mult_in::LinearNoBias{T}
    dim_pair::Int
end

function PairformerBlock(T::Type, dim_pair::Int; heads::Int=8, dim_head::Int=32)
    pair_self = AttentionPairBias(T, dim_pair, dim_pairwise=dim_pair, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    pair_self_attn = PreLayerNorm(pair_self, dim_pair, T)
    
    pair_cross = Attention(T, dim_pair, heads=heads, dim_head=dim_head)
    pair_cross_attn = PreLayerNorm(pair_cross, dim_pair, T)
    
    pair_trans = Transition(T, dim_pair, mult=4)
    pair_transition = PreLayerNorm(pair_trans, dim_pair, T)
    
    triangle_mult_out = LinearNoBias(T, dim_pair, dim_pair)
    triangle_mult_in = LinearNoBias(T, dim_pair, dim_pair)
    
    return PairformerBlock{T}(pair_self_attn, pair_cross_attn, pair_transition, triangle_mult_out, triangle_mult_in, dim_pair)
end

function (block::PairformerBlock{T})(pair::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    seq_len, _, dim, batch = size(pair)
    
    pair_flat = reshape(pair, seq_len, seq_len * dim * batch)
    pair_self_out = block.pair_self_attn(pair_flat, pair)
    pair = pair .+ reshape(pair_self_out, seq_len, seq_len, dim, batch)
    
    pair_flat = reshape(pair, seq_len, seq_len * dim * batch)
    pair_cross_out = block.pair_cross_attn(pair_flat)
    pair = pair .+ reshape(pair_cross_out, seq_len, seq_len, dim, batch)
    
    triangle_out = zeros(T, size(pair)...)
    for b in 1:batch
        for i in 1:seq_len
            for j in 1:seq_len
                acc = zeros(T, dim)
                for k in 1:seq_len
                    p_ik = pair[i, k, :, b]
                    p_kj = pair[k, j, :, b]
                    proj_out = block.triangle_mult_out(reshape(p_ik, dim, 1))
                    proj_in = block.triangle_mult_in(reshape(p_kj, dim, 1))
                    acc .+= reshape(proj_out, dim) .* reshape(proj_in, dim)
                end
                triangle_out[i, j, :, b] = acc
            end
        end
    end
    pair = pair .+ triangle_out
    
    pair_flat = reshape(pair, seq_len * seq_len, dim * batch)
    pair_trans_out = block.pair_transition(pair_flat)
    pair = pair .+ reshape(pair_trans_out, seq_len, seq_len, dim, batch)
    
    return pair
end

struct CryoEMIntegration{T<:AbstractFloat}
    map_encoder::Vector{Any}
    cross_attn::Attention{T}
    fusion_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    dim::Int
end

function CryoEMIntegration(T::Type, dim::Int; num_layers::Int=6, heads::Int=8)
    encoder_layers = []
    current_dim = 1
    for i in 1:num_layers
        out_dim = min(2^(i+3), dim)
        conv = LinearNoBias(T, current_dim, out_dim)
        push!(encoder_layers, conv)
        current_dim = out_dim
    end
    
    cross_attn = Attention(T, dim, heads=heads, dim_head=div(dim, heads))
    fusion_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim * 2, dim)
    
    return CryoEMIntegration{T}(encoder_layers, cross_attn, fusion_proj, dim)
end

function (cryo::CryoEMIntegration{T})(density_map::AbstractArray{T}, protein_repr::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    x = density_map
    for conv in cryo.map_encoder
        x = conv(x)
        x = GELU()(x)
    end
    
    map_features = x
    
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(protein_repr)
    map_len = size(map_features, 1)
    
    protein_flat = reshape(protein_repr, seq_len, dim * batch)
    map_flat = reshape(map_features, map_len, dim * batch)
    
    attn_out = cryo.cross_attn(protein_flat)
    attn_out = reshape(attn_out, seq_len, dim, batch)
    
    fused = cat(protein_repr, attn_out, dims=2)
    fused_flat = reshape(fused, seq_len, 2 * dim * batch)
    
    output = cryo.fusion_proj(fused_flat)
    output = reshape(output, seq_len, dim, batch)
    
    return output
end

struct QuantumCircuitLayer{T<:AbstractFloat}
    num_qubits::Int
    circuit_depth::Int
    param_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    result_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    backend::Symbol
end

function QuantumCircuitLayer(T::Type, num_qubits::Int, dim::Int; circuit_depth::Int=10, backend::Symbol=:simulator)
    param_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, num_qubits * circuit_depth * 3)
    result_proj = LinearNoBias(T, num_qubits, dim)
    
    return QuantumCircuitLayer{T}(num_qubits, circuit_depth, param_proj, result_proj, backend)
end

function (qc::QuantumCircuitLayer{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(x)
    
    x_flat = reshape(x, seq_len, dim * batch)
    params = qc.param_proj(x_flat)
    params = reshape(params, seq_len, qc.num_qubits, qc.circuit_depth, 3, batch)
    
    measurements = zeros(T, seq_len, qc.num_qubits, batch)
    
    for b in 1:batch
        for s in 1:seq_len
            state = zeros(ComplexF64, 2^qc.num_qubits)
            state[1] = 1.0 + 0.0im
            
            for d in 1:qc.circuit_depth
                for q in 1:qc.num_qubits
                    theta = params[s, q, d, 1, b]
                    phi = params[s, q, d, 2, b]
                    lambda = params[s, q, d, 3, b]
                    
                    gate = [
                        cos(theta/2) -exp(im*lambda)*sin(theta/2);
                        exp(im*phi)*sin(theta/2) exp(im*(phi+lambda))*cos(theta/2)
                    ]
                    
                    state = apply_single_qubit_gate(state, gate, q, qc.num_qubits)
                end
                
                for q in 1:(qc.num_qubits-1)
                    state = apply_cnot(state, q, q+1, qc.num_qubits)
                end
            end
            
            for q in 1:qc.num_qubits
                prob = measure_qubit_prob(state, q, qc.num_qubits)
                measurements[s, q, b] = T(prob)
            end
        end
    end
    
    measurements_flat = reshape(measurements, seq_len, qc.num_qubits * batch)
    output = qc.result_proj(measurements_flat)
    output = reshape(output, seq_len, dim, batch)
    
    return output
end

function apply_single_qubit_gate(state::Vector{ComplexF64}, gate::Matrix{ComplexF64}, target::Int, num_qubits::Int)
    dim = 2^num_qubits
    new_state = copy(state)
    
    block_size = 2^(num_qubits - target)
    num_blocks = div(dim, block_size)
    
    for block in 0:(num_blocks÷2-1)
        for i in 0:(block_size÷2-1)
            idx0 = block * block_size + i
            idx1 = idx0 + block_size ÷ 2
            
            a = state[idx0 + 1]
            b = state[idx1 + 1]
            
            new_state[idx0 + 1] = gate[1,1] * a + gate[1,2] * b
            new_state[idx1 + 1] = gate[2,1] * a + gate[2,2] * b
        end
    end
    
    return new_state
end

function apply_cnot(state::Vector{ComplexF64}, control::Int, target::Int, num_qubits::Int)
    dim = 2^num_qubits
    new_state = copy(state)
    
    for i in 0:(dim-1)
        control_bit = (i >> (num_qubits - control)) & 1
        
        if control_bit == 1
            target_bit = (i >> (num_qubits - target)) & 1
            flipped_idx = i ⊻ (1 << (num_qubits - target))
            
            new_state[i + 1] = state[flipped_idx + 1]
        end
    end
    
    return new_state
end

function measure_qubit_prob(state::Vector{ComplexF64}, qubit::Int, num_qubits::Int)
    dim = 2^num_qubits
    prob_one = 0.0
    
    for i in 0:(dim-1)
        qubit_bit = (i >> (num_qubits - qubit)) & 1
        if qubit_bit == 1
            prob_one += abs2(state[i + 1])
        end
    end
    
    return prob_one
end

struct VariationalQuantumEigensolver{T<:AbstractFloat}
    num_qubits::Int
    hamiltonian_proj::LinearNoBias{T}
    ansatz_depth::Int
    optimizer_steps::Int
end

function VariationalQuantumEigensolver(T::Type, num_qubits::Int, dim::Int; ansatz_depth::Int=5, optimizer_steps::Int=50)
    hamiltonian_proj = LinearNoBias(T, dim, num_qubits * num_qubits)
    
    return VariationalQuantumEigensolver{T}(num_qubits, hamiltonian_proj, ansatz_depth, optimizer_steps)
end

function (vqe::VariationalQuantumEigensolver{T})(x::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(x)
    
    x_flat = reshape(x, seq_len, dim * batch)
    hamiltonian_params = vqe.hamiltonian_proj(x_flat)
    hamiltonian_params = reshape(hamiltonian_params, seq_len, vqe.num_qubits, vqe.num_qubits, batch)
    
    energies = zeros(T, seq_len, batch)
    
    for b in 1:batch
        for s in 1:seq_len
            H = hamiltonian_params[s, :, :, b]
            H = (H + H') / 2
            
            theta = randn(T, vqe.num_qubits * vqe.ansatz_depth * 3)
            
            for step in 1:vqe.optimizer_steps
                state = zeros(ComplexF64, 2^vqe.num_qubits)
                state[1] = 1.0 + 0.0im
                
                param_idx = 1
                for d in 1:vqe.ansatz_depth
                    for q in 1:vqe.num_qubits
                        ry_angle = theta[param_idx]
                        rz_angle = theta[param_idx + 1]
                        param_idx += 2
                        
                        ry = [cos(ry_angle/2) -sin(ry_angle/2); sin(ry_angle/2) cos(ry_angle/2)]
                        rz = [exp(-im*rz_angle/2) 0; 0 exp(im*rz_angle/2)]
                        
                        state = apply_single_qubit_gate(state, ry, q, vqe.num_qubits)
                        state = apply_single_qubit_gate(state, rz, q, vqe.num_qubits)
                    end
                end
                
                energy = real(dot(state, construct_hamiltonian_matrix(H, vqe.num_qubits) * state))
                
                theta .-= T(0.01) .* randn(T, length(theta))
            end
            
            energies[s, b] = T(real(energy))
        end
    end
    
    return energies
end

function construct_hamiltonian_matrix(H::AbstractMatrix{T}, num_qubits::Int) where T
    dim = 2^num_qubits
    full_H = zeros(ComplexF64, dim, dim)
    
    for i in 1:size(H, 1)
        for j in 1:size(H, 2)
            if abs(H[i, j]) > 1e-10
                pauli_z_i = construct_pauli_z(i, num_qubits)
                pauli_z_j = construct_pauli_z(j, num_qubits)
                full_H .+= H[i, j] .* (pauli_z_i * pauli_z_j)
            end
        end
    end
    
    return full_H
end

function construct_pauli_z(qubit::Int, num_qubits::Int)
    dim = 2^num_qubits
    Z = zeros(ComplexF64, dim, dim)
    
    for i in 0:(dim-1)
        qubit_bit = (i >> (num_qubits - qubit)) & 1
        sign = qubit_bit == 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0
        Z[i+1, i+1] = sign
    end
    
    return Z
end

struct GraphNeuralNetwork{T<:AbstractFloat}
    node_embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    edge_embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    message_layers::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    readout_layer::LinearNoBias{T}
    num_layers::Int
    dim::Int
end

function GraphNeuralNetwork(T::Type, node_features::Int, edge_features::Int, dim::Int; num_layers::Int=6)
    node_embed = LinearNoBias(T, node_features, dim)
    edge_embed = LinearNoBias(T, edge_features, dim)
    
    message_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, dim * 3, dim) for _ in 1:num_layers]
    readout = LinearNoBias(T, dim, dim)
    
    return GraphNeuralNetwork{T}(node_embed, edge_embed, message_layers, readout, num_layers, dim)
end

function (gnn::GraphNeuralNetwork{T})(node_features::AbstractArray{T}, edge_features::AbstractArray{T}, adjacency::AbstractMatrix{Bool}) where T
    num_nodes = size(node_features, 1)
    batch = size(node_features, 3)
    
    node_features_flat = reshape(node_features, num_nodes, size(node_features, 2) * batch)
    h = gnn.node_embedding(node_features_flat)
    h = reshape(h, num_nodes, gnn.dim, batch)
    
    num_edges = size(edge_features, 1)
    edge_features_flat = reshape(edge_features, num_edges, size(edge_features, 2) * batch)
    e = gnn.edge_embedding(edge_features_flat)
    e = reshape(e, num_edges, gnn.dim, batch)
    
    for layer_idx in 1:gnn.num_layers
        h_new = zeros(T, size(h)...)
        
        edge_idx = 1
        for i in 1:num_nodes
            for j in 1:num_nodes
                if adjacency[i, j]
                    for b in 1:batch
                        h_i = h[i, :, b]
                        h_j = h[j, :, b]
                        e_ij = e[edge_idx, :, b]
                        
                        message_input = vcat(h_i, h_j, e_ij)
                        message_input_reshaped = reshape(message_input, gnn.dim * 3, 1)
                        
                        message = gnn.message_layers[layer_idx](message_input_reshaped)
                        message = reshape(message, gnn.dim)
                        
                        h_new[i, :, b] .+= message
                    end
                    edge_idx += 1
                end
            end
        end
        
        h = h .+ GELU()(h_new)
    end
    
    h_flat = reshape(h, num_nodes, gnn.dim * batch)
    output = gnn.readout_layer(h_flat)
    output = reshape(output, num_nodes, gnn.dim, batch)
    
    return output
end

struct MachineLearningForceField{T<:AbstractFloat}
    atom_embedding::LinearNoBias{T}
    interaction_layers::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    energy_head::LinearNoBias{T}
    force_head::LinearNoBias{T}
    cutoff_radius::T
    num_layers::Int
    dim::Int
end

function MachineLearningForceField(T::Type, num_atom_types::Int, dim::Int; num_layers::Int=5, cutoff_radius::T=T(5.0)) where T
    atom_embed = LinearNoBias(T, num_atom_types, dim)
    
    interaction_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, dim * 2 + 1, dim) for _ in 1:num_layers]
    
    energy_head = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 1)
    force_head = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 3)
    
    return MachineLearningForceField{T}(atom_embed, interaction_layers, energy_head, force_head, cutoff_radius, num_layers, dim)
end

function (mlff::MachineLearningForceField{T})(atom_types::AbstractVector{Int}, coords::AbstractMatrix{T}) where T
    num_atoms = length(atom_types)
    
    atom_onehot = zeros(T, num_atoms, maximum(atom_types))
    for (i, atype) in enumerate(atom_types)
        atom_onehot[i, atype] = T(1.0)
    end
    
    h = mlff.atom_embedding(atom_onehot)
    
    for layer in mlff.interaction_layers
        h_new = zeros(T, size(h)...)
        
        for i in 1:num_atoms
            for j in 1:num_atoms
                if i != j
                    r_ij = coords[:, j] .- coords[:, i]
                    dist = norm(r_ij)
                    
                    if dist < mlff.cutoff_radius
                        cutoff_val = T(0.5) * (cos(T(π) * dist / mlff.cutoff_radius) + T(1.0))
                        
                        interaction_input = vcat(h[i, :], h[j, :], [dist])
                        interaction_input_reshaped = reshape(interaction_input, mlff.dim * 2 + 1, 1)
                        
                        message = layer(interaction_input_reshaped)
                        message = reshape(message, mlff.dim)
                        
                        h_new[i, :] .+= message .* cutoff_val
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        h = h .+ SiLU()(h_new)
    end
    
    atom_energies = mlff.energy_head(h)
    total_energy = sum(atom_energies)
    
    forces = mlff.force_head(h)
    
    return total_energy, forces
end

struct AdaptiveConfidenceCalibrator{T<:AbstractFloat}
    calibration_net::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    temperature::T
    dim::Int
end

function AdaptiveConfidenceCalibrator(T::Type, dim::Int; num_layers::Int=3, temperature::T=T(1.0)) where T
    layers = [LinearNoBias(T, i == 1 ? dim : dim÷2, i == num_layers ? 1 : dim÷2) for i in 1:num_layers]
    
    return AdaptiveConfidenceCalibrator{T}(layers, temperature, dim)
end

function (calibrator::AdaptiveConfidenceCalibrator{T})(predictions::AbstractArray{T}, features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    seq_len, pred_dim, batch = size(predictions)
    feat_len, feat_dim, _ = size(features)
    
    features_flat = reshape(features, feat_len, feat_dim * batch)
    
    x = features_flat
    for (i, layer) in enumerate(calibrator.calibration_net)
        x = layer(x)
        if i < length(calibrator.calibration_net)
            x = SiLU()(x)
        end
    end
    
    confidence = sigmoid.(x ./ calibrator.temperature)
    confidence = reshape(confidence, feat_len, 1, batch)
    
    if seq_len != feat_len
        confidence = repeat(confidence, inner=(1, pred_dim, 1))
        confidence = confidence[1:seq_len, :, :]
    else
        confidence = repeat(confidence, inner=(1, pred_dim, 1))
    end
    
    calibrated_predictions = predictions .* confidence
    
    return calibrated_predictions, confidence
end

function sigmoid(x::T) where T
    return T(1.0) / (T(1.0) + exp(-x))
end

struct MultiChainSymmetryDetector{T<:AbstractFloat}
    chain_encoder::LinearNoBias{T}
    symmetry_classifier::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    max_fold::Int
    dim::Int
end

function MultiChainSymmetryDetector(T::Type, dim::Int; max_fold::Int=12, num_layers::Int=4)
    chain_encoder = LinearNoBias(T, dim, dim)
    
    classifier_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, i == 1 ? dim : dim÷2, i == num_layers ? max_fold : dim÷2) for i in 1:num_layers]
    
    return MultiChainSymmetryDetector{T}(chain_encoder, classifier_layers, max_fold, dim)
end

function (detector::MultiChainSymmetryDetector{T})(chain_features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_chains, dim, batch = size(chain_features)
    
    chain_features_flat = reshape(chain_features, num_chains, dim * batch)
    encoded = detector.chain_encoder(chain_features_flat)
    encoded = reshape(encoded, num_chains, detector.dim, batch)
    
    pooled = dropdims(mean(encoded, dims=1), dims=1)
    pooled_flat = reshape(pooled, detector.dim, batch)
    
    x = pooled_flat
    for (i, layer) in enumerate(detector.symmetry_classifier)
        x = layer(x)
        if i < length(detector.symmetry_classifier)
            x = SiLU()(x)
        end
    end
    
    symmetry_logits = reshape(x, detector.max_fold, batch)
    symmetry_probs = softmax(symmetry_logits, dims=1)
    
    return symmetry_probs
end

struct DisorderRegionPredictor{T<:AbstractFloat}
    sequence_encoder::Vector{Any}
    disorder_head::LinearNoBias{T}
    confidence_head::LinearNoBias{T}
    dim::Int
end

function DisorderRegionPredictor(T::Type, dim::Int; num_layers::Int=6, heads::Int=8)
    encoder_layers = []
    for i in 1:num_layers
        attn = Attention(T, dim, heads=heads, dim_head=div(dim, heads))
        attn_ln = PreLayerNorm(attn, dim, T)
        trans = Transition(T, dim, mult=4)
        trans_ln = PreLayerNorm(trans, dim, T)
        push!(encoder_layers, (attn_ln, trans_ln))
    end
    
    disorder_head = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 1)
    confidence_head = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 1)
    
    return DisorderRegionPredictor{T}(encoder_layers, disorder_head, confidence_head, dim)
end

function (predictor::DisorderRegionPredictor{T})(sequence_features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(sequence_features)
    
    x = reshape(sequence_features, seq_len, dim * batch)
    
    for (attn_ln, trans_ln) in predictor.sequence_encoder
        x = x .+ attn_ln(x)
        x = x .+ trans_ln(x)
    end
    
    disorder_logits = predictor.disorder_head(x)
    disorder_probs = sigmoid.(disorder_logits)
    
    confidence_logits = predictor.confidence_head(x)
    confidence_scores = sigmoid.(confidence_logits)
    
    disorder_probs = reshape(disorder_probs, seq_len, 1, batch)
    confidence_scores = reshape(confidence_scores, seq_len, 1, batch)
    
    return disorder_probs, confidence_scores
end

struct AlternativeConformationSampler{T<:AbstractFloat}
    variance_predictor::LinearNoBias{T}
    num_samples::Int
    dim::Int
end

function AlternativeConformationSampler(T::Type, dim::Int; num_samples::Int=5)
    variance_predictor = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 3)
    
    return AlternativeConformationSampler{T}(variance_predictor, num_samples, dim)
end

function (sampler::AlternativeConformationSampler{T})(coords::AbstractArray{T}, features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_atoms, _, batch = size(coords)
    seq_len, dim, _ = size(features)
    
    features_flat = reshape(features, seq_len, dim * batch)
    variances = sampler.variance_predictor(features_flat)
    variances = reshape(variances, seq_len, 3, batch)
    variances = softplus.(variances)
    
    if num_atoms != seq_len
        variances = repeat(variances, inner=(div(num_atoms, seq_len), 1, 1))
        variances = variances[1:num_atoms, :, :]
    end
    
    all_conformations = zeros(T, num_atoms, 3, batch, sampler.num_samples)
    
    for sample_idx in 1:sampler.num_samples
        noise = randn(T, size(coords)...)
        
        perturbed_coords = coords .+ noise .* sqrt.(variances)
        
        all_conformations[:, :, :, sample_idx] = perturbed_coords
    end
    
    return all_conformations
end

function softplus(x::T) where T
    return log(T(1.0) + exp(x))
end

struct CovalentModificationPredictor{T<:AbstractFloat}

function CovalentModificationPredictor(T::Type, dim::Int; num_mod_types::Int=20, num_layers::Int=4)

function (predictor::CovalentModificationPredictor{T})(residue_features::AbstractArray{T}) where T

    x = residue_features_flat
    for (i, layer) in enumerate(predictor.mod_classifier)
        x = layer(x)
        if i < length(predictor.mod_classifier)
            x = GELU()(x)
        end
    end
    
    mod_logits = reshape(x, seq_len, predictor.num_mod_types, batch)
    mod_probs = softmax(mod_logits, dims=2)
    
    return mod_probs
end

struct IonProteinDockingModule{T<:AbstractFloat}
    ion_encoder::LinearNoBias{T}
    protein_site_encoder::LinearNoBias{T}
    interaction_scorer::LinearNoBias{T}
    num_ion_types::Int
    dim::Int
end

function IonProteinDockingModule(T::Type, dim::Int; num_ion_types::Int=10)
    ion_encoder = LinearNoBias(T, num_ion_types, dim)
    protein_site_encoder = LinearNoBias(T, dim, dim)
    interaction_scorer = LinearNoBias(T, dim * 2, 1)
    
    return IonProteinDockingModule{T}(ion_encoder, protein_site_encoder, interaction_scorer, num_ion_types, dim)
end

function (docking::IonProteinDockingModule{T})(ion_types::AbstractVector{Int}, protein_features::AbstractArray{T}, protein_coords::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_ions = length(ion_types)
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(protein_features)
    num_atoms = size(protein_coords, 1)
    
    ion_onehot = zeros(T, num_ions, docking.num_ion_types)
    for (i, ion_type) in enumerate(ion_types)
        if ion_type >= 1 && ion_type <= docking.num_ion_types
            ion_onehot[i, ion_type] = T(1.0)
        end
    end
    
    ion_features = docking.ion_encoder(ion_onehot)
    
    protein_features_flat = reshape(protein_features, seq_len, dim * batch)
    site_features = docking.protein_site_encoder(protein_features_flat)
    site_features = reshape(site_features, seq_len, docking.dim, batch)
    
    binding_scores = zeros(T, num_ions, seq_len, batch)
    
    for b in 1:batch
        for i in 1:num_ions
            for s in 1:seq_len
                combined = vcat(ion_features[i, :], site_features[s, :, b])
                combined_reshaped = reshape(combined, docking.dim * 2, 1)
                
                score = docking.interaction_scorer(combined_reshaped)
                binding_scores[i, s, b] = score[1]
            end
        end
    end
    
    binding_probs = softmax(binding_scores, dims=2)
    
    return binding_probs
end

struct SmallMoleculeComplexBuilder{T<:AbstractFloat}
    ligand_encoder::LinearNoBias{T}
    protein_encoder::LinearNoBias{T}
    interaction_net::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    pose_generator::LinearNoBias{T}
    ligand_dim::Int
    protein_dim::Int
    hidden_dim::Int
end

function SmallMoleculeComplexBuilder(T::Type, ligand_dim::Int, protein_dim::Int, hidden_dim::Int; num_layers::Int=6)
    ligand_encoder = LinearNoBias(T, ligand_dim, hidden_dim)
    protein_encoder = LinearNoBias(T, protein_dim, hidden_dim)
    
    interaction_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim) for _ in 1:num_layers]
    
    pose_generator = LinearNoBias(T, hidden_dim, 6)
    
    return SmallMoleculeComplexBuilder{T}(ligand_encoder, protein_encoder, interaction_layers, pose_generator, ligand_dim, protein_dim, hidden_dim)
end

function (builder::SmallMoleculeComplexBuilder{T})(ligand_features::AbstractArray{T}, protein_features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_ligand_atoms, ligand_feat_dim = size(ligand_features)
    seq_len, protein_feat_dim, batch = size(protein_features)
    
    ligand_encoded = builder.ligand_encoder(ligand_features)
    
    protein_features_flat = reshape(protein_features, seq_len, protein_feat_dim * batch)
    protein_encoded = builder.protein_encoder(protein_features_flat)
    protein_encoded = reshape(protein_encoded, seq_len, builder.hidden_dim, batch)
    
    protein_pooled = dropdims(mean(protein_encoded, dims=1), dims=1)
    
    ligand_pooled = dropdims(mean(ligand_encoded, dims=1), dims=1)
    
    poses = zeros(T, batch, 6)
    for b in 1:batch
        combined = vcat(ligand_pooled, protein_pooled[:, b])
        
        x = reshape(combined, builder.hidden_dim * 2, 1)
        for layer in builder.interaction_net
            x = layer(x)
            x = GELU()(x)
        end
        
        pose = builder.pose_generator(x)
        poses[b, :] = reshape(pose, 6)
    end
    
    return poses
end

end

function check_convergence!(monitor::RecyclingConvergenceMonitor{T}, current_loss::T) where T
    push!(monitor.history, current_loss)
    
    if length(monitor.history) < monitor.patience + 1
        return false
    end
    
    recent_losses = monitor.history[end-monitor.patience:end]
    
    converged = true
    for i in 2:length(recent_losses)
        if abs(recent_losses[i] - recent_losses[i-1]) > monitor.convergence_threshold
            converged = false
            break
        end
    end
    
    return converged
end

struct DynamicMSADepthAdapter{T<:AbstractFloat}

    max_depth::Int

end

function DynamicMSADepthAdapter(T::Type, dim::Int; min_depth::Int=32, max_depth::Int=512)
    complexity_scorer = LinearNoBias(T, dim, 1)
    
    return DynamicMSADepthAdapter{T}(complexity_scorer, min_depth, max_depth, dim)
end

function (adapter::DynamicMSADepthAdapter{T})(sequence_features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(sequence_features)
    
    sequence_features_flat = reshape(sequence_features, seq_len, dim * batch)
    pooled = dropdims(mean(reshape(sequence_features_flat, seq_len, dim, batch), dims=1), dims=1)
    pooled_flat = reshape(pooled, dim, batch)
    
    complexity_scores = adapter.complexity_scorer(pooled_flat)
    complexity_scores = reshape(complexity_scores, batch)
    
    complexity_normalized = sigmoid.(complexity_scores)
    
    optimal_depths = adapter.min_depth .+ round.(Int, (adapter.max_depth - adapter.min_depth) .* complexity_normalized)
    
    return optimal_depths
end

    dim::Int
end

function CrossSpeciesHomologyTransfer(T::Type, dim::Int; num_species::Int=100, num_layers::Int=4)
    species_encoder = LinearNoBias(T, num_species, dim)
    
    transfer_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, dim * 2, dim) for _ in 1:num_layers]
    
    return CrossSpeciesHomologyTransfer{T}(species_encoder, transfer_layers, num_species, dim)
end

function (transfer::CrossSpeciesHomologyTransfer{T})(source_features::AbstractArray{T}, source_species::Int, target_species::Int) where T
    seq_len, dim, batch = size(source_features)
    
    source_onehot = zeros(T, 1, transfer.num_species)
    source_onehot[1, source_species] = T(1.0)
    source_encoding = transfer.species_encoder(source_onehot)
    
    target_onehot = zeros(T, 1, transfer.num_species)
    target_onehot[1, target_species] = T(1.0)
    target_encoding = transfer.species_encoder(target_onehot)
    
    species_delta = target_encoding .- source_encoding
    species_delta = reshape(species_delta, transfer.dim)
    
    transferred_features = copy(source_features)
    
    for b in 1:batch
        for s in 1:seq_len
            feat = transferred_features[s, :, b]
            combined = vcat(feat, species_delta)
            combined_reshaped = reshape(combined, transfer.dim * 2, 1)
            
            x = combined_reshaped
            for layer in transfer.transfer_net
                x = layer(x)
                x = GELU()(x)
            end
            
            transferred_features[s, :, b] = reshape(x, transfer.dim)
        end
    end
    
    return transferred_features
end

struct GradientBasedStructureRefinement{T<:AbstractFloat}
    energy_network::Vector{LinearNoBias{T}}
    learning_rate::T
    num_steps::Int
    dim::Int
end

function GradientBasedStructureRefinement(T::Type, dim::Int; num_steps::Int=50, learning_rate::T=T(0.01), num_layers::Int=4)
    energy_layers = [LinearNoBias(T, i == 1 ? dim + 3 : dim, i == num_layers ? 1 : dim) for i in 1:num_layers]
    
    return GradientBasedStructureRefinement{T}(energy_layers, learning_rate, num_steps, dim)
end

function (refine::GradientBasedStructureRefinement{T})(coords::AbstractArray{T}, features::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_atoms, _, batch = size(coords)
    seq_len, dim, _ = size(features)
    
    refined_coords = copy(coords)
    
    for b in 1:batch
        for step in 1:refine.num_steps
            gradients = zeros(T, num_atoms, 3)
            
            for i in 1:num_atoms
                feat_idx = min(i, seq_len)
                feat = features[feat_idx, :, b]
                coord = refined_coords[i, :, b]
                
                input_vec = vcat(feat, coord)
                input_reshaped = reshape(input_vec, refine.dim + 3, 1)
                
                x = input_reshaped
                for (layer_idx, layer) in enumerate(refine.energy_network)
                    x = layer(x)
                    if layer_idx < length(refine.energy_network)
                        x = GELU()(x)
                    end
                end
                
                energy = x[1]
                
                epsilon = T(1e-5)
                for d in 1:3
                    coord_plus = copy(coord)
                    coord_plus[d] += epsilon
                    
                    input_plus = vcat(feat, coord_plus)
                    input_plus_reshaped = reshape(input_plus, refine.dim + 3, 1)
                    
                    x_plus = input_plus_reshaped
                    for (layer_idx, layer) in enumerate(refine.energy_network)
                        x_plus = layer(x_plus)
                        if layer_idx < length(refine.energy_network)
                            x_plus = GELU()(x_plus)
                        end
                    end
                    
                    energy_plus = x_plus[1]
                    
                    gradients[i, d] = (energy_plus - energy) / epsilon
                end
            end
            
            refined_coords[:, :, b] .-= refine.learning_rate .* gradients
        end
    end
    
    return refined_coords
end

    norm_type::Float64
    adaptive::Bool
    history::Vector{T}
    percentile::T
end

function AdaptiveGradientClipper(T::Type; max_norm::T=T(1.0), norm_type::Float64=2.0, adaptive::Bool=true, percentile::T=T(0.95)) where T
    return AdaptiveGradientClipper{T}(max_norm, norm_type, adaptive, T[], percentile)
end

function clip_gradients!(clipper::AdaptiveGradientClipper{T}, gradients::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    total_norm = norm(gradients, clipper.norm_type)
    
    push!(clipper.history, total_norm)
    if length(clipper.history) > 1000
        clipper.history = clipper.history[end-999:end]
    end
    
    if clipper.adaptive && length(clipper.history) > 10
        sorted_norms = sort(clipper.history)
        idx = Int(ceil(length(sorted_norms) * clipper.percentile))
        adaptive_max_norm = sorted_norms[idx]
    else
        adaptive_max_norm = clipper.max_norm
    end
    
    if total_norm > adaptive_max_norm
        scale = adaptive_max_norm / (total_norm + T(1e-6))
        gradients .*= scale
    end
    
    return gradients
end

        'S' => 16, 'T' => 17, 'W' => 18, 'Y' => 19, 'V' => 20,
        'X' => 21
    )
    
    tokens = [get(aa_to_idx, aa, 21) for aa in sequence]
    return tokens
end

function generate_random_msa(sequence::String, num_sequences::Int=128)
    seq_len = length(sequence)
    tokens = sequence_to_tokens(sequence)
    
    msa = zeros(Int, num_sequences, seq_len)
    msa[1, :] = tokens
    
    for i in 2:num_sequences
        mutated = copy(tokens)
        num_mutations = rand(1:div(seq_len, 10))
        positions = rand(1:seq_len, num_mutations)
        for pos in positions
            mutated[pos] = rand(1:21)
        end
        msa[i, :] = mutated
    end
    
    return msa
end

function generate_random_pair_tokens(seq_len::Int)
    pair_tokens = rand(1:65, seq_len, seq_len)
    for i in 1:seq_len
        pair_tokens[i, i] = 1
    end
    return pair_tokens
end

function predict_structure(model::AlphaFold3{T}, sequence::String; num_msa::Int=128) where T
    seq_len = length(sequence)
    
    single_tokens = reshape(sequence_to_tokens(sequence), seq_len, 1)
    
    msa = generate_random_msa(sequence, num_msa)
    msa_3d = reshape(msa, num_msa, seq_len, 1)
    
    pair_tokens = generate_random_pair_tokens(seq_len)
    pair_3d = reshape(pair_tokens, seq_len, seq_len, 1)
    
    coords, single_repr, pair_repr = model(msa_3d, pair_3d, single_tokens, return_structure=true)
    
    return coords
end

function parallel_map(f::Function, data::AbstractVector; use_threads::Bool=true, use_distributed::Bool=false)
    if use_distributed && nprocs() > 1
        return pmap(f, data)
    elseif use_threads && Threads.nthreads() > 1
        if THREADSX_AVAILABLE
            return ThreadsX.map(f, data)
        elseif POLYESTER_AVAILABLE
            result = similar(data, Any)
            Polyester.@batch for i in eachindex(data)
                result[i] = f(data[i])
            end
            return result
        else
            result = similar(data, Any)
            Threads.@threads for i in eachindex(data)
                result[i] = f(data[i])
            end
            return result
        end
    else
        return map(f, data)
    end
end

function parallel_reduce(op::Function, f::Function, data::AbstractVector; use_threads::Bool=true)
    if use_threads && Threads.nthreads() > 1
        if THREADSX_AVAILABLE
            return ThreadsX.mapreduce(f, op, data)
        else
            mapped = parallel_map(f, data, use_threads=true)
            return reduce(op, mapped)
        end
    else
        return mapreduce(f, op, data)
    end
end

function distributed_predict(model::AlphaFold3{T}, sequences::Vector{String}; num_workers::Int=nprocs()) where T

        return results
    elseif DAGGER_AVAILABLE
        tasks = [Dagger.@spawn predict_structure(model, seq) for seq in sequences]
        results = [fetch(task) for task in tasks]

function gpu_accelerated_matmul(A::AbstractMatrix{T}, B::AbstractMatrix{T}) where T

        A_gpu = CuArray(A)
        B_gpu = CuArray(B)
        C_gpu = A_gpu * B_gpu

    elseif AMDGPU_AVAILABLE

    elseif METAL_AVAILABLE
        A_gpu = MtlArray(A)
        B_gpu = MtlArray(B)
        C_gpu = A_gpu * B_gpu
        return Array(C_gpu)
    elseif OCTAVIAN_AVAILABLE
        return Octavian.matmul(A, B)
    else
        return A * B
    end
end

function optimized_batch_matmul(batched_A::AbstractArray{T,3}, batched_B::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    batch_size = size(batched_A, 3)
    m, k = size(batched_A, 1), size(batched_A, 2)
    k2, n = size(batched_B, 1), size(batched_B, 2)
    
    if k != k2
        error("Dimension mismatch in batch matrix multiplication")
    end
    
    result = zeros(T, m, n, batch_size)
    
    if CUDA_AVAILABLE && CUDA.functional()
        A_gpu = CuArray(batched_A)
        B_gpu = CuArray(batched_B)
        
        for b in 1:batch_size
            result[:, :, b] = Array(A_gpu[:, :, b] * B_gpu[:, :, b])
        end
    elseif LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
        @turbo for b in 1:batch_size
            for j in 1:n
                for i in 1:m
                    acc = zero(T)
                    for kk in 1:k
                        acc += batched_A[i, kk, b] * batched_B[kk, j, b]
                    end
                    result[i, j, b] = acc
                end
            end
        end
    else
        for b in 1:batch_size
            result[:, :, b] = batched_A[:, :, b] * batched_B[:, :, b]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

function strided_computation(data::AbstractArray{T}) where T

        return @strided sum(data .^ 2)
    else
        return sum(data .^ 2)
    end
end

    if LINEARSOLVE_AVAILABLE
        prob = LinearProblem(A, b)
        sol = solve(prob)
        return sol.u
    elseif KRYLOV_AVAILABLE && method == :krylov
        x, stats = Krylov.gmres(A, b)

    else
        return A \ b
    end
end

function optimize_structure_energy(coords::AbstractArray{T}, energy_func::Function; max_iter::Int=100) where T
    if JUMP_AVAILABLE
        model = Model()
        n_atoms, n_dims, batch = size(coords)
        
        @variable(model, x[1:n_atoms, 1:n_dims, 1:batch])
        
        for b in 1:batch
            for i in 1:n_atoms
                for d in 1:n_dims
                    set_start_value(x[i, d, b], coords[i, d, b])
                end
            end
        end
        
        @objective(model, Min, energy_func(x))
        
        optimize!(model)
        
        return value.(x)
    elseif MADNLP_AVAILABLE
        return coords
    else
        learning_rate = T(0.01)
        current_coords = copy(coords)
        
        for iter in 1:max_iter
            energy = energy_func(current_coords)
            
            grad = zeros(T, size(current_coords))
            epsilon = T(1e-5)
            
            for idx in CartesianIndices(current_coords)
                current_coords[idx] += epsilon
                energy_plus = energy_func(current_coords)
                current_coords[idx] -= epsilon
                
                grad[idx] = (energy_plus - energy) / epsilon
            end
            
            current_coords .-= learning_rate .* grad
        end
        
        return current_coords
    end
end

function validate_structure(coords::AbstractArray{T}, sequence::String) where T
    num_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    seq_len = length(sequence)
    
    validation_results = Dict{String,Any}()
    
    if num_atoms != seq_len
        validation_results["length_match"] = false
        validation_results["warning"] = "Number of atoms ($num_atoms) doesn't match sequence length ($seq_len)"
    else
        validation_results["length_match"] = true
    end
    
    bond_lengths = []
    for i in 1:(num_atoms-1)
        dist = norm(coords[i, :, 1] - coords[i+1, :, 1])
        push!(bond_lengths, dist)
    end
    
    avg_bond_length = mean(bond_lengths)
    std_bond_length = std(bond_lengths)
    
    validation_results["avg_bond_length"] = avg_bond_length
    validation_results["std_bond_length"] = std_bond_length
    validation_results["bond_length_range"] = (minimum(bond_lengths), maximum(bond_lengths))
    
    if avg_bond_length < 2.5 || avg_bond_length > 5.0
        validation_results["bond_length_warning"] = "Average bond length outside typical range (3.0-4.0 Å)"
    end
    
    center_of_mass = dropdims(mean(coords, dims=1), dims=1)
    validation_results["center_of_mass"] = center_of_mass
    
    max_extent = maximum(norm(coords[i, :, 1] - center_of_mass[:, 1]) for i in 1:num_atoms)
    validation_results["max_extent"] = max_extent
    validation_results["radius_of_gyration"] = sqrt(mean([norm(coords[i, :, 1] - center_of_mass[:, 1])^2 for i in 1:num_atoms]))
    
    return validation_results
end

function compute_contact_map(coords::AbstractArray{T}, threshold::T=T(8.0)) where T
    num_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    contact_map = zeros(Bool, num_atoms, num_atoms)
    
    if LOOPVECTORIZATION_AVAILABLE
        distances = zeros(T, num_atoms, num_atoms)
        @turbo for i in 1:num_atoms
            for j in 1:num_atoms
                if i != j
                    dx = coords[i, 1, 1] - coords[j, 1, 1]
                    dy = coords[i, 2, 1] - coords[j, 2, 1]
                    dz = coords[i, 3, 1] - coords[j, 3, 1]
                    distances[i, j] = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)
                end
            end
        end
        contact_map = distances .< threshold
    else
        for i in 1:num_atoms
            for j in (i+1):num_atoms
                dist = norm(coords[i, :, 1] - coords[j, :, 1])
                if dist < threshold
                    contact_map[i, j] = true
                    contact_map[j, i] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return contact_map
end

function compute_ramachandran_angles(coords::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    num_residues = size(coords, 1)
    
    phi_angles = zeros(T, num_residues)
    psi_angles = zeros(T, num_residues)
    
    for i in 2:(num_residues-1)
        C_prev = coords[i-1, :, 1]
        N_curr = coords[i, :, 1]
        CA_curr = coords[i, :, 1]
        C_curr = coords[i, :, 1]
        N_next = coords[i+1, :, 1]
        
        phi_angles[i] = compute_dihedral_angle(C_prev, N_curr, CA_curr, C_curr)
        psi_angles[i] = compute_dihedral_angle(N_curr, CA_curr, C_curr, N_next)
    end
    
    return phi_angles, psi_angles
end

function compute_dihedral_angle(p1::AbstractVector{T}, p2::AbstractVector{T}, p3::AbstractVector{T}, p4::AbstractVector{T}) where T
    b1 = p2 - p1
    b2 = p3 - p2
    b3 = p4 - p3
    
    n1 = cross(b1, b2)
    n2 = cross(b2, b3)
    
    m1 = cross(n1, b2 / norm(b2))
    
    x = dot(n1, n2)
    y = dot(m1, n2)
    
    angle = atan(y, x)
    
    return angle
end

function compute_secondary_structure(coords::AbstractArray{T}, sequence::String) where T
    num_residues = size(coords, 1)
    
    ss_assignment = fill('C', num_residues)
    
    for i in 1:(num_residues-3)
        CO_i = coords[i, :, 1]
        NH_i3 = coords[i+3, :, 1]
        
        dist = norm(CO_i - NH_i3)
        
        if dist < 3.5
            ss_assignment[i:i+3] .= 'H'
        end
    end
    
    for i in 1:(num_residues-4)
        if ss_assignment[i] == 'C' && ss_assignment[i+4] == 'C'
            CA_i = coords[i, :, 1]
            CA_i2 = coords[i+2, :, 1]
            CA_i4 = coords[i+4, :, 1]
            
            dist_i_i2 = norm(CA_i - CA_i2)
            dist_i2_i4 = norm(CA_i2 - CA_i4)
            
            if dist_i_i2 > 6.0 && dist_i2_i4 > 6.0
                ss_assignment[i:i+4] .= 'E'
            end
        end
    end
    
    return String(ss_assignment)
end

function compute_solvent_accessible_surface_area(coords::AbstractArray{T}, radii::Vector{T}=fill(T(1.8), size(coords, 1))) where T
    num_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    probe_radius = T(1.4)
    
    sasa = zeros(T, num_atoms)
    
    num_points = 100
    
    for i in 1:num_atoms
        atom_center = coords[i, :, 1]
        atom_radius = radii[i] + probe_radius
        
        accessible_points = 0
        
        for _ in 1:num_points
            theta = rand() * 2 * T(π)
            phi = acos(2 * rand() - 1)
            
            test_point = atom_center .+ atom_radius .* [sin(phi)*cos(theta), sin(phi)*sin(theta), cos(phi)]
            
            is_accessible = true
            for j in 1:num_atoms
                if i != j
                    dist = norm(test_point - coords[j, :, 1])
                    if dist < (radii[j] + probe_radius)
                        is_accessible = false
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if is_accessible
                accessible_points += 1
            end
        end
        
        sasa[i] = (accessible_points / num_points) * 4 * T(π) * atom_radius^2
    end
    
    return sasa
end

function compute_tm_score(coords1::AbstractArray{T}, coords2::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    n = size(coords1, 1)
    
    if size(coords2, 1) != n
        error("Structures must have the same number of atoms")
    end
    
    d0 = T(1.24) * cbrt(n - 15) - T(1.8)
    
    coords1_centered = coords1 .- mean(coords1, dims=1)
    coords2_centered = coords2 .- mean(coords2, dims=1)
    
    tm_score = zero(T)
    
    for i in 1:n
        di = norm(coords1_centered[i, :, 1] - coords2_centered[i, :, 1])
        tm_score += T(1.0) / (T(1.0) + (di / d0)^2)
    end
    
    tm_score /= n
    
    return tm_score
end

function compute_rmsd(coords1::AbstractArray{T}, coords2::AbstractArray{T}) where T
    n = size(coords1, 1)
    
    if size(coords2, 1) != n
        error("Structures must have the same number of atoms")
    end
    
    coords1_centered = coords1 .- mean(coords1, dims=1)
    coords2_centered = coords2 .- mean(coords2, dims=1)
    
    sum_sq_dist = zero(T)
    
    for i in 1:n
        sum_sq_dist += norm(coords1_centered[i, :, 1] - coords2_centered[i, :, 1])^2
    end
    
    rmsd = sqrt(sum_sq_dist / n)
    
    return rmsd
end

function visualize_structure_ascii(coords::AbstractArray{T}, sequence::String; width::Int=80, height::Int=40) where T
    num_atoms = size(coords, 1)

    for i in 1:num_atoms

        col = Int(round(x_norm * (width - 1))) + 1
        row = Int(round((1 - y_norm) * (height - 1))) + 1
        
        col = clamp(col, 1, width)
        row = clamp(row, 1, height)
        
        if i <= length(sequence)

        end

    println("="^width)
    
    for row in 1:height

    end
    
    println("="^width * "\n")
end
